info.description:
Social-as-a-Service backend: actors, posts, comments, edges (follow/mute/block/restrict), feeds, stories, DMs, moderation. Two lanes. Customer lane: your backend calls /v1/communities/{community_id}/* with a workspace API key (`Authorization: Bearer pcft_live_...`) and asserts the acting end-user via the standardized `actor_id` (body field or `?actor_id=` query parameter). Admin lane: /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/* accepts an API key bearer, a platform user bearer, or the `auth_token` session cookie, and covers community CRUD, moderation, and analytics.

## Rate limits

Every `/v1` route is limited per client IP to 20 requests per second and 600 per minute. Each response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit-short`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining-short`, `X-RateLimit-Reset-short` (the one-second window) and the same three with `-long` (the one-minute window). Over either limit the response is `429` with code `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds.
